tested_skill: Predict the effect of removing an anchor
question: A student indicates the Username field on the Streamlit page and Studio Web returns a green selection and a blue selection. The student deletes the blue selection to simplify the target. What is the most likely consequence?

options.A: The activity becomes less reliable because the target loses the stable reference element used to locate it
options.B: The activity fails immediately because a target cannot be saved without two selections
options.C: The activity types into the wrong browser tab because scope is defined by the blue selection
options.D: The activity runs faster with no change in reliability because anchors are only used at design time

answer_rationale: The blue selection is the anchor, which provides a stable reference for locating a target whose own attributes or position may change. Removing it can reduce reliability but does not necessarily make the target invalid immediately.
knowledge_point: UiPath anchors improve selector reliability by providing a stable reference element

question: The Streamlit login requires the Submit button to be pressed twice. Which implementation is described as the pattern preferred for a production automation, rather than a workaround for this exercise?

options.A: One Click activity with Verify execution enabled, retrying until the page changes
options.B: Two consecutive Click activities targeting the same button
options.C: One Click activity preceded by a fixed Delay of five seconds
options.D: A Retry Scope containing the Use Application/Browser activity

answer_rationale: A production workflow should verify the expected state change and retry the interaction when necessary. Two fixed clicks are the exercise workaround, while a fixed delay is brittle and retrying the entire browser scope is unnecessarily broad.
knowledge_point: Production UI automation should verify an interaction outcome instead of relying on fixed repeated clicks or delays

question: Inside For Each Row in Data Table, the Fill Form activity is given CurrentRow as its data source and no field mapping is configured. On what basis does the activity decide which value goes into which form field?

options.A: It matches data table column names to the form field names automatically
options.B: It fills the fields in the left-to-right order in which they appear on the form
options.C: It uses the selectors captured when the table was indicated
options.D: It requires the Item name property to be renamed to match each field

answer_rationale: The Week 1 exercise states that Fill Form uses AI to match DataTable column names with UI field names when CurrentRow is supplied as the data source.
knowledge_point: Fill Form automatically maps DataTable column names to matching form field names

tested_skill: Predict loop behavior after an omitted activity
question: A student omits the second Click activity that selects Submit another response. What behaviour will be observed when the workflow runs against a three-row data table?

options.A: All three rows are submitted but the third response is duplicated
options.B: Only the first row is submitted and the loop fails on the second iteration because the form is not returned to a blank state
options.C: No rows are submitted because Fill Form cannot locate the fields
options.D: Three rows are submitted correctly because the form resets automatically after each submission

answer_rationale: After the first submission, the workflow must select Submit another response to return to a blank form. Without that step, the next loop iteration cannot fill the expected fields.
knowledge_point: A multi-row form loop must reset the form before processing the next CurrentRow

tested_skill: Evaluate a string against an anchored regular expression
question: The validation condition uses the pattern ^\w+\.\w+@\w+\.\w+$. Which of the following addresses would be matched by this pattern? (\w matches 0-9, A-Z, a-z and underscore; \. matches a single dot; @ matches @; ^ matches start of text; $ matches end of text; + represents one or more occurrences.)
answer_rationale: The pattern requires exactly two non-empty word-character groups separated by one dot before @, followed by exactly two word-character groups separated by one dot after @. Only pe6202.pace@gmail.com has that exact shape.
knowledge_point: Anchored regex patterns must match the complete input and every required literal separator

tested_skill: Predict the effect of an incorrect row offset
question: For Each Row in Spreadsheet has Has headers set to False. A student writes the result using the expression "H" & (CurrentRowIndex + 1).ToString instead of the prescribed + 2. What is the effect on the output spreadsheet?

options.A: Every status value is written one row too high, so the first result overwrites the column header
options.B: Every status value is written one row too low, leaving row 2 permanently blank
options.C: The workflow throws an error because Row 0 does not exist in Google Sheets
options.D: There is no effect because the Google Sheets connector corrects the offset automatically

answer_rationale: CurrentRowIndex is zero-based. Replacing the prescribed +2 mapping with +1 shifts every target one physical row upward, causing the first write to target H1 and overwrite the header.
knowledge_point: A zero-based CurrentRowIndex requires the correct physical spreadsheet row offset

tested_skill: Explain activity placement inside a loop
question: In the Write Cell activity for the item description, the Cell field is built as "D" & CurrentRowNumber, where CurrentRowNumber is assigned Index + 1 immediately before the write. Why must the assignment sit inside the loop rather than before it?

options.A: Because the Set Variable Value activity can only be placed inside a loop
options.B: Because the Index changes on each iteration, so the destination row must be recalculated for every line item
options.C: Because the variable scope is limited to the For Each activity
options.D: Because Google Sheets locks the cell reference once the first write is completed

answer_rationale: Each line item has a different zero-based Index. CurrentRowNumber must therefore be recalculated as Index + 1 during every iteration before constructing the target cell address.
knowledge_point: Loop-dependent row calculations must be performed inside the line-item loop

question: After the initial run of Document Understanding, each invoice overwrites the previous one in the Individual sheet. The prescribed fix adds Read Range, then Write Range with How to write set to Append, then Delete Range with Delete behaviour set to Clear. What role does the Delete Range activity play?

options.A: It removes the Overall sheet so that the next run starts from an empty file
options.B: It deletes the processed PDF from the input folder to prevent reprocessing
options.C: It clears the Individual staging sheet so the next invoice is not appended together with the previous one
options.D: It clears the Document Data variable so the next extraction starts empty

answer_rationale: Individual is the temporary staging sheet for one invoice. After its rows are appended to Overall, Delete Range with Clear resets Individual before the next PDF is processed.
knowledge_point: Clear the Individual staging sheet after appending each invoice to Overall

tested_skill: Explain control flow after a search loop
question: In the Appointment Check Workflow, a second If activity is placed outside the For Each Row in Spreadsheet loop and tests whether Out_ProcessReturn is empty text. Why is this placement necessary?

options.A: Because Out_ProcessReturn cannot be read while a loop is executing
options.B: Because the result is only known after every appointment row has been examined without a match
options.C: Because the Log Message activity is not permitted inside a loop
options.D: Because the loop resets output arguments to empty at the end of each iteration

answer_rationale: The workflow can conclude that an appointment was not found only after the loop has checked every row. If Out_ProcessReturn is still empty at that point, it can safely assign Appointment not found.
knowledge_point: A not-found result must be assigned after the search loop has exhausted all rows
